title: Figure 8: Fiber optical oxygen sensor with optical fibers mated to plastic prisms
description: Composite figure with a micrograph of a fiber-tipped sensor (upper left), a color illustration labeling "fiber optics," "silicone cover," "prism" and "silicone carrier" (upper right), and a photograph of two small sensor devices beside a matchstick for scale (bottom). The caption reads "Figure 8. A Fiber Optical Oxygen Sensor Showing Two Optical Fibers Mated to Plastic Prisms That are Coated With an Oxygen-Sensor Coating, Usually a Fluorescent Ruthenium Compound."
